correctness.rationale: At distance two, the joint midpoint jump rate is q and each individual midpoint jump has rate 1-q; at all greater distances only independent inward/outward moves occur. The Dirichlet hitting problem reduces to h_k=(d-1)^(-(k-2))h_2 for k>=2 plus two exact local equations. Solving gives positive rational closed forms; the derivative of both amplitudes is strictly positive for d>=3. Moment duality yields covariance p(1-p)h_k for the stationary Bernoulli-product limit. The standalone exact-rational program independently verifies 2430 generator and truncation identities, but finite tests are not taken as a proof of the infinite statement.

value.rationale: This is the full natural two-point observable for a newly defined broadcast-voter model on the canonical nonamenable homogeneous graph. It provides exact spatial decay and a sharp observation/parameter inversion result from a single nearest-neighbor covariance, while showing that broad higher-order broadcast coordination changes amplitudes but not the pair-correlation length. These are interpretable stationary statistics beyond the established abstract measure classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
